units.source_text: 那雅致的格子门外还有一层格子门，那里也摆上了折叠椅，而且铺面很深。

en.t: Outside the elegant lattice door there was another lattice door, and folding chairs had been set out there as well; the shop was also very deep.

units.source_text: 这种格局，在今天看来，也许是旧时遗留下来的痕迹。

en.t: Seen from today, this kind of arrangement was perhaps a remnant left over from earlier times.

units.source_text: 秀男觉得疑惑的是，一个富有京都风采、堂堂和服批发商的女儿，同那个在北山杉村圆木厂当雇工的姑娘怎么会是姐妹呢？

en.t: What puzzled Hideo was how the daughter of a dignified kimono wholesaler, so full of Kyoto character, could be sisters with the girl working as a hired hand at a log mill in the Kitayama cedar village.

units.source_text: 可是这样的问题，秀男不应该刨根问底。

en.t: But Hideo ought not to pry too deeply into such a question.
